_comment: Tenancy for OIDC-authenticated callers. The IdP says who someone is; this
file says which project of this gateway they may act in. A subject that
matches nothing here is authenticated but has no project, and every tool is
Resolution order: `subjects` first, then `groups`. A SUBJECT ROW IS AN
OVERRIDE, NOT AN ADDITION: when one matches, groups are not consulted at
all, so a subject row with empty `roles` TAKES AWAY what the groups would
have given. That is what makes it usable during an incident.
Several groups are merged only when they name the SAME project; two
projects are refused rather than resolved, because picking one would make a
tenant boundary depend on iteration order.
Note what this does and does not bound: the projects and roles reachable
here are yours, but which of them a token lands on is chosen by the IdP's
group claim. Leave `groups` empty and list subjects if you want none of that.
